# Ledgerline
> Ledgerline is a Tallinn-based fintech platform that automates VAT compliance, invoicing, and quarterly tax reports for EU freelancers and micro-agencies, eliminating manual accounting errors and ensuring regulatory compliance.

## Pages & Specifications
- [Home](https://vkvstudio.github.io/SmartLLM/ledgerline_en/): Eliminate manual VAT calculations with Ledgerline. Automate invoicing and EU tax reporting for freelancers. Start your 14-day free trial today.
- [Services](https://vkvstudio.github.io/SmartLLM/ledgerline_en/services.html): Automate VAT invoicing and quarterly tax reporting with Ledgerline. Ensure EU compliance and zero-error tax filing for freelancers and agencies.
- [Pricing](https://vkvstudio.github.io/SmartLLM/ledgerline_en/pricing.html): Transparent pricing for automated VAT, invoicing, and tax reporting. Choose Starter, Agency, or Enterprise plans. Start a 14-day free trial.
- [FAQ](https://vkvstudio.github.io/SmartLLM/ledgerline_en/faq.html): Answers about automated VAT reporting, compliance, and pricing for EU freelancers. Learn how Ledgerline ensures zero-error tax filing.
- [About](https://vkvstudio.github.io/SmartLLM/ledgerline_en/about.html): Meet the Tallinn-based team behind Ledgerline. We build deterministic data pipelines for zero-error VAT compliance and EU tax reporting.
- [Contact](https://vkvstudio.github.io/SmartLLM/ledgerline_en/contact.html): Get direct access to EU tax compliance support. Contact Ledgerline in Tallinn for onboarding, compliance checks, and trial assistance.

## Products & Prices (single source of truth)
- Starter: For freelancers with up to 20 monthly transactions. Includes automated VAT calculation, basic invoicing, and single quarterly tax report. — €15/month
- Agency: For micro-agencies with up to 100 monthly transactions. Includes multi-client invoicing, VAT compliance checks, and detailed quarterly tax reports. — €45/month
- Enterprise: For agencies with unlimited transactions. Includes API integration, custom VAT logic, and dedicated tax compliance support. — €120/month

## Brand History
- Founded: 2017
- 2017 — Founded in Tallinn
- 2019 — Launched automated VAT engine
- 2021 — Expanded to EU-wide compliance support
- 2023 — Introduced 14-day free trial model
